SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Final Price Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Every soldier who takes up arms does so knowing the cost. Those who give their lives for our survival will earn a place among the heroes whose names echo across the stars for generations to come.

effects.li: Pawns will never surrender or give up and leave

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Intervention Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Those who support our enemies will not know peace.

effects.li: When a faction visits your settlement, this faction may launch a raid to attack the visitors

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Scorched Earth Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: If we cannot hold what is ours, neither will the enemy.

effects.li: When abandoning or losing a settlement, defenders attempt to destroy valuable structures and resources

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: No Mercy Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: We will not spare the lives of our enemies, those who fall will be eliminated.

effects.li: Pawns will eliminate any downed colonist they can reach directly

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Forces Preservation Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: There is a time and place to give your life in service of a cause. We cannot afford to squander the lives of our people.

effects.li: Pawns will retreat and give up faster than usual

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Hit and Run Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Striking multiple times gives us the advantage in combat.

effects.li: During raids, this faction will retreat and regroup to attack again later

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Familial Succession Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Our family tree holds strong ties to our leadership, and they shall arise to the occasion.

effects.li: New leaders will tend to be family members of the faction leader

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Gracious Repatriation
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: We welcome the return of our kin, we could have lost them forever.

effects.li: Captured leaders returned alive grant +50% relation bonus
Prisoners returned healthy grant +50% relation bonus

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Fallen Veneration
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Giving our people a proper send-off is imperative.

effects.li: Gain small relation bonuses when sending this faction corpses of their members

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Leader's Legacy
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: The fall of our leaders only embolden us to push forward and become stronger!

effects.li: Power Struggle duration is reduced by 50%
Power Void duration is reduced by 50%

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Absolute Borders Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Foreign borders are sacred. Aggression against another faction is condemned regardless of justification.

effects.li: Will not trade with factions who have recently raided another faction

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Defense in Depth Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Let the enemy come to us, we will not abandon our defenses.

effects.li: Pawns will not leave their base when being raided

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Attrition Warfare Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: Our enemy will fall under our superior production power.

effects.li: Raids from this faction will favor siege tactics

SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.label: Mutual Defense Doctrine
SimpleLeadership.DoctrineDef.description: An attack upon one of our allies is an attack upon us all.

effects.li: May retaliate against factions that recently attacked one of their allies
